events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked that famous zebra crossing. Still sounds as good today. What's your favourite track from Abbey Road?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking hard, still sounding incredible. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Bonehead's Bank Holiday? Not for Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today. Still got it, still sounds biblical. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to Imagine. A timeless message, a timeless song. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listened to music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years since the original iPod dropped. Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a thing. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite 007, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon and Monty Python legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From silly walks to 'Don't mention the war!', happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese. What's your favourite Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered a double dose of genius with 'The White Album'. So many tracks, so many stories. What's your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Thirty-five years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy. Still unforgettable. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles got reflective with 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that changed everything. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Forty-six years since the tragic death of John Lennon, a musical icon and peace activist.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace endure. What's the song that reminds you most of his incredible legacy?
